name: Antigravity
description: Adds gravity to any arbitrary UI element

enabled.name: Enable Antigravity
enabled.description: Adds gravity to most UI elements

enable-everywhere.name: Enable everywhere
enable-everywhere.description: Adds gravity to all UI elements, including in-game and in-editor (Dangerous)

gravity-x.name: Gravity (x)
gravity-x.description: Gravity in the x-axis, where positive x points right.

gravity-y.name: Gravity (y)
gravity-y.description: Gravity in the y-axis, where positive y points up.
